question: What division of the eight octads is sought to be fully known without limit?
premises: The division of eight octads is the object
Full knowledge of it is desired
The knowing is sought without limit
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify the division or the manner of knowing
plain_english: And I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
